description:
A polar bear hunt, stage by stage: when researchers reviewed polar bear attacks on people, most were predatory. Doug follows a polar bear hunt from a kilometer away to zero: the nose that finds seals under the snow, the fur that hides it from thermal cameras, a record three-minute dive, a Russian town under a state of emergency, Canada's polar bear jail, and why hungry bears are spending longer on land.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
